title: Shiseido Ultimune Power Infusing Concentrate 50ml
description_en: Shiseido's globally acclaimed serum that supercharges all products layered after it. The ImuGeneration Technology activates skin's natural immunity, visibly reducing signs of aging in 4 weeks.
